description_en: Queries whether Anti-DDoS Origin is authorized to obtain information about the assets within the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 检查防护包服务的授权状态，即是否授权防护包查询ECS服务器信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp check-grant --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --is-slr true --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckGrant

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.
parameters.description_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the region where the Anti-DDoS Origin instance resides.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

- **true**

- **false**
